**Risk flags:**  
- Single shareholder holds 54.63%

**Overview:**  
Mega Mutiara Catering Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company in the Food & Beverage industry that manufactures bread and cakes for retail shops. It was incorporated on **1990‑11‑17** and is based in Pulau Pinang. The firm has **4 directors**, with the top shareholder owning **54.63%** of the equity. Reported revenues are **RM36,015,739**, **RM34,216,773** and **RM32,080,974**, while equity figures stand at **RM27,805,271**, **RM24,516,584** and **RM20,046,169**. No legal cases are recorded.
